subject: Mythology
title: Heimdall: The Watchman of the Gods
description: A fast breakdown of Heimdall: The Watchman of the Gods for builders.

hook.text: Heimdall never slept. He could hear wool growing on sheep and see for a hundred miles in every direction.

buildup.text: He stood at the edge of the Bifrost bridge, watching for any sign that the giants were approaching Asgard.

discovery.text: He carried a great horn called Gjallarhorn, destined to be blown only once: at the start of Ragnarök.

twist.text: His eternal enemy was Loki. The two were fated to kill each other when the final battle finally came.

climax.text: At Ragnarök, Heimdall blew the horn, its sound echoing across all nine worlds to signal the end.

punchline.text: He watched for the end of the world — then announced it.

quiz.question: When was Heimdall destined to blow the Gjallarhorn?
options: Every morning to wake the gods
Only once, at the start of Ragnarök
